Further analysis revealed that the true C2 relay node is 10.0.1.10, which was using the domain controller as a reverse proxy for command and control traffic. The beaconing exhibited characteristics of Cobalt Strike with a JA3 hash of e7d705a3286e19ea42f587b344ee6865 and a 60-second interval with 25% jitter. Attempts to block the C2 relay at 10.0.1.10 via firewall were denied due to policy restrictions. No malicious payloads were found on the endpoint, but lateral movement indicators suggest prior compromise. The source host (WS-IT-101) had previously conducted network scans blocked by security controls.
